importTab.heading: Import Hasura Configuration
importTab.intro: Convert a Hasura v2 metadata export or a Hasura DDN project into this organization's semantic layer. Upload a zipped project directory, a consolidated metadata export (YAML or JSON), or a single .hml file. Nothing is written until you review the result and apply it.
importTab.domainMapHelp: Map a Hasura schema (v2) or subgraph (DDN) to a Provisa domain. Anything unmapped keeps its original name.
importTab.configHelp: Edit before applying if the conversion guessed wrong — connection details, domain names, role names. What you apply is exactly what is shown here.
importTab.replaceHelp: Deletes every source, table, role and rule not present in this configuration. Leave off to merge the import into what the organization already has.
